bio: Mallory Court Hotel's restaurant boasts 3 AA Rosettes, providing guests with elegant surroundings to enjoy Afternoon Tea. Their beautiful restaurant has oak panelled walls, creating a warm country house feel, and possesses views over their gardens, and the countryside.  They serve a traditional Afternoon Tea with assorted sandwiches, scones served with clotted cream and strawberry jam, a selection of homemade cakes and fancies served alongside fine teas poured in china cups. All Afternoon Teas can be enjoyed out on the terrace overlooking the hotel’s gardens or choose your own spot with a Picnic Afternoon Tea  Mallory Court Hotel is privately owned by the Eden Hotel Collection, winners of the 'AA Small Hotel Group of the Year' 2014-2015.
